directive: Persist each substantive finding in janus-meta-registry as it is promoted, with provenance, epistemic status, falsifiers and next killer-test. Do not rely on chat history as the canonical scientific record.
firewalls: A real bathymetric or geophysical anomaly is not evidence of an artificial structure.
Circular morphology alone is not diagnostic of impact.
Cruise/project polygon membership is not equivalent to valid MBES swath coverage at a target point.
A web/API timeout or HTTP 5xx is UNKNOWN_SERVICE_FAILURE, not a zero-result dataset.
Absence of a shock marker in a shallow core is negative evidence only for the sampled interval, not a proof against impact if crater fill may not have been penetrated.
Hypothesis ranking must remain reversible when new data arrive.
